column1: # Design from a REFERENCE database, for targets the sample cannot meet.
# These pairs ARE NOT confirmed against the sample; only whether the sample
# supports them at all is measured.
# The list was widened on 2026-08-01. The reason is what the level check
# measured:
#   Bacteroidaceae_ailesi     amplifies 0 of 65 Bacteroides species
#   Alistipes_cinsi           amplifies 0 of 22 Alistipes species
#   Podospora_pseudopauciseta gives no product in the target species and
#                             amplifies its sibling species instead
#   Microascaceae/Trichoderma what it amplifies in the target species is
#                             Petriella musispora
# The database column now takes more than one file, comma separated. The
# competitor set is not limited to what is written by hand: the other species of
# the target's genus are found FROM THE DATA and added (the
# --sibling-competitors option of design_from_reference.py, on by default). In
# the earlier version the Podospora design was made with 29 competitor sequences
# while the level check's verification panel held 242 records across 50 species,
# and that difference was exactly the cause of the failure. So the hand written
# sibling species names, Podospora anserina and comata among them, were TAKEN OUT
# of the list: they are found from the data now, and a hand written list can be
# incomplete and therefore gives false confidence. What stays by hand is only the
# competitors from OTHER genera.
